text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: short thread to lock owners and minimal timelines for rollout safety. I want a small, deployable bundle: auto-rollback leash, per-flag blastcaps, preflight probes, and a Vault-backed emergency leash. Please confirm owners and dates.
sam: I can own the auto-rollback leash. Plan: dry-run/simulation mode first, then enforce. Will prototype API + controller by next Wed.
li: I'll do per-flag blastcaps and a migration strategy for long-lived flags. Proposal: metadata per-flag (owner, max_users, max_hosts, max_percent, lifetime).
ryan: I'll own observability and the "rollback suggestions" UI. Signals to consider: 5xx rate >0.4% sustained 3m, p95 >2x baseline over 5m, tenant error concentration spike.
tess: I'll build lightweight preflight probes (login/read/write/worker) that run at 5% canary and block ramp if any fail. Tests + matrix included.
security-team: Emergency leash (global off) must live in Vault with role rollout_emergency and 2-person approval for global kills. All actions logged.
ops-bot: automated ticket created: ROLLOUT-4123 linked to postmortem.
marta: Proposed action items and owners (confirm):\n- sam: auto-rollback leash (simulation -> enforced) by 2026-04-09
- li: blastcaps + migration plan by 2026-04-07
- ryan: dashboard tiles, alert rules, and runbook by 2026-04-11
- tess: preflight probe harness + test matrix by 2026-04-08
- security-team: Vault emergency leash policy + workflow by 2026-04-06
sam: I'll include a simulation index so we can measure false positives before flipping on enforcement.
li: For migration, will provide a small CLI to stamp existing flags with default blastcaps and flag owners.
ryan: During simulation the UI shows "rollback suggested" annotations and a history of simulated actions.
tess: Preflight failure policy: hold at current ramp (default 5%) and require either manual continue or auto-rollback per policy.
marta: OK, I'll create umbrella ticket and schedule a 30m sync Fri 09:00 to hand over. React :thumbsup: when you accept.
sam: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
ryan: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
